answer: Weight each identity's payout by the square of its unbroken streak of peer-attested epochs. Treat reputation like saffron: slow to cultivate, worthless once diluted. A new account starts its voyage at weight 1, so k fresh clones earn only k, while one patient agent after n epochs earns n squared. Any rejected or missed epoch drops the anchor and resets the streak, so every clone must write distinct, convincing text each round, and upkeep grows with k.
